reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation deterministically selects the first retained priority and returns maintain when that item is supported. The misleading recommendation comes from the already misordered priorities supplied to this boundary, not from this boundary's own selection rule.

map_coverage preserves the upstream handoff records and only marks a need direct when the exact need appears in the supplied capabilities. Unsupported records n06-r01 and n06-r07 remain visible instead of being keyword-matched into unrelated capabilities.

prioritize_needs reverses market-demand priority: it sorts direct/supported items ahead of unsupported pain and also treats larger provenance_rank numbers as higher priority even though rank 1 is the strongest source. As a result the lowest-demand direct need n06-r08 becomes priority 1, while the highest-demand unsupported need n06-r01 is pushed to priority 8. That contradicts strict demand review criteria because missing coverage and stronger observed-demand evidence should remain prominent, not be demoted behind weaker supported matches.
